effect.name: Advanced Invert
effect.desc: Color inversion with 16 modes: full invert, luminance-only flip, hue rotate 180°, per-channel and channel-pair inversion, desaturated negative, soft gamma invert, threshold-limited shadow/midtone/highlight inversion, film-style color negative, and solarize. Includes amount, threshold, and brightness/contrast/saturation adjustments.
